402170302.text: Ah! Honorary Knight, Paimon! Sorry, I was chatting away and didn't even notice you arrive. It's so good to see you again!

402170305.text: Oh, I was just discussing competition stuff with Mr. Heinz. So what brings you to Dragonspine? Not a commission, I assume?

402170306.text: Nope, we just saw some cool flyer and thought we'd come see what all the fuss is about.

subQuests.subQuestName: Go look for the familiar faces

402170401.text: Hello. Are Varesa and Xilonen around?

402170402.text: Ah, so you're looking for the captain and vice captain.

402170403.text: #...{NICKNAME}? I thought I was seeing things... I can't believe it's really you!

402170405.text: Don't even go there... Please, I'm supposed to be on vacation here.

402170406.text: However much I want to finish my thesis, I'm only human. I've been fighting a losing battle with it recently.

402170407.text: Right now, I feel completely defeated by it. It's knocked me to the ground, and I'm just gonna lie here until I'm ready to get up and face it again. Until then, I'm begging you — please, please don't bring up my thesis.

402170412.text: Wow, we've run into so many people we know already. What a small world!

402170413.text: Since we all know Varesa and Xilonen, that makes things a lot easier.

402170414.text: We heard they're taking part in the cross country contest, so we thought we'd come say hi.

402170415.text: They're not here right now. But if you're not in a hurry, you're welcome to stick around the camp and wait.

402170416.text: Sounds good. Your tents are really cool by the way... Ah, and there's that stash of comic books Amber mentioned.

402170409.text: You don't remember me? ...I guess that's fair. After everything you've been through, all the people you've met, you probably don't have space in your brain for small-timers like me.

402170410.text: I'm Alrani, an aspiring herbad at the Akademiya... Technically just a driyosh in the meantime, hehe...

402170411.text: But once I finish my graduation thesis, I'll be a herbad before long!

subQuests.subQuestName: Head to the training grounds to find Varesa

402170501.text: Hey, Varesa! We've come to watch you train, hehe!

402170502.text: #Wait, was that Paimon? Paimon! {NICKNAME}! Ah, I've missed you guys so much!

402170503.text: You and Xilonen tell Varesa about the events of the day so far.

402170504.text: Ahahaha! So Alrani and Yigang were just quoting lines at you? Way to make a first impression...

402170505.text: Exactly! Their whole conversation was like a closed loop. Even Paimon couldn't find a way in!

402170506.text: If it were me, I would have started with: "Maximum power!"

402170507.text: Mmm, that doesn't exactly welcome people into the conversation either.

402170508.text: Especially not when they see you hoisting Minnie up into the air and spinning her around in circles the first time you all meet up. Before anyone's even said a word.

402170509.text: Oh crumbs... Yeah, now I think about it, that's pretty embarrassing...

402170510.text: I mean, we all kinda knew each other... but only through writing letters and trading illustrations. That was our first time meeting in person.

402170511.text: I just got overexcited when I recognized Minnie, hehe... Couldn't help myself.

402170512.text: Hold on, you two traveled here together, right? So why did you say "the Legion of Soulblazers and I" when you were introducing everyone earlier?

402170513.text: Aren't you part of their team?

402170514.text: It's because I'm not a member of their fan club. Nepecha is. I'm sort of standing in for her.

402170517.text: Pretty good. She's eating, getting enough sleep, and doing well in her studies. Hooked on comic books, though. And that's where Minnie comes in — they're pen pals.

402170518.text: Nepecha's always telling me how amazing Minnie is. She's such a great artist, knows how to make comic book props, gives the best life advice...

402170519.text: Honestly, she made her sound more like a mom than a peer... So, I was pretty surprised when I got her and found out that nope, Minnie's actually pretty young.

402170520.text: Anyway, when Nepecha heard that Minnie had suggested a cross country contest on Dragonspine, she wanted to join in.

402170521.text: But... She is in no condition for extreme sports, and well, she knows it. So instead, she asked me to go represent her at the contest and say hi to Minnie while I'm here.

402170522.text: Hehe, and I'd been preparing to go traveling for a while anyway, so we figured we'd team up.

402170523.text: Uh-huh, and before I knew it, I'd inexplicably ended up with the title of vice captain...

402170524.text: W—Well, yeah! You were the obvious choice! You're clearly captain material, and... y'know the best vice captains are the ones you can turn to and say, "keep this up, I know you'll make captain one day!"

402170525.text: You could also argue that the person who is "clearly captain material" should be made captain, but hey — what would I know? ...Ugh, never mind, I refuse to get drawn into that whole discussion...

402170526.text: Anyway, I'm mostly here to buy souvenirs for Nepecha. Huh, it's like, Soulblazer-themed... uh...

402170528.text: Oh... Okay, "merch," I guess. Uh-huh. Basically, badges, novelty notepaper with character art, reprints of old comics, painted wooden character cutouts...

402170529.text: ...Um, what's with that look, Varesa? Did I... Did I say something wrong?

402170530.text: N—No, nothing's wrong. It's just, kinda strange hearing you talk all about that merch with such a straight face...

402170531.text: The thought of Xilonen, the master craftswoman, carrying boxes of merch back home to Natlan... Hehe, it's such a funny image!

402170532.text: That's a pretty long list, too. Did Nepecha really ask for all that!?

402170533.text: Oh, no. She'd never ask other people to buy gifts for her. It's not in her nature.

402170534.text: But based on what I know about her, I'm sure she'll appreciate some, uh... merch. I still prefer "souvenirs" personally, but...

402170535.text: Oh, definitely! Nepecha will be over the moon! Hehe, you really understand her, Xilonen. You're like her older sister.

402170536.text: Close enough, I mean, we are technically family. Although, we haven't known each other long, so I can't claim to understand her that well. I'm still learning.

402170537.text: *panting*... Push-up... I mean, Varesa... I finished my push-ups...

402170538.text: That makes four sets, right? Good job! Time for a breather.

402170539.text: #Minnie, I'd like to introduce you to {NICKNAME} and Paimon. They're friends of me and Xilonen. We met in Natlan.

402170540.text: Wait... blond hair, flying companion... Are you... Mondstadt's Honorary Knight?

402170601.text: Oh, we're almost back at the camp. After what Xilonen was saying earlier, lemme give this to you before I forget...

402170602.text: Here! The Soulblazer Saga, volume 2. I figured other people might wanna read it, so I made sure to bring some extra copies.

402170603.text: Unfortunately, it looks like I somehow forgot to pack volume 1 in my luggage... Shame. It's always best to start from the beginning when you're trying to get your friends into a new comic series...

402170604.text: Anyway, take a look in your free time, see what you think... Ahhh, I really hope you like it! It would be soooo cool to have an awesome person like you in the fanbase!

402170607.text: Alright, we're gonna meet back up with the others. Come hang out with us again soon, okay?

402170608.text: Ugh, why'd it have to end there? Fietena and her buddies fought an amazing battle, Paimon really wants to see what happens next!

402170609.text: Let's go meet up with Varesa and her team when we get the chance. We can ask them what happens in the next volume.

402172301.text: We're still setting up the course. If you were hoping to take a look around, I'm afraid now's not the time.

402173301.text: You know when the contest starts, right? Don't forget to come and watch on the day!

402173501.text: Thanks! It'll be nice to have something to read after my shift ends.

402173502.text: Don't mention it. I'm always happy to meet people who share my interests.

402179920.text: Varesa and Minnie are training together. They've been at it all day.

402179921.text: But, it is freezing out here, so it's time to call it.
